stories.title: Colombian military plane with 125 people crashes
stories.summary: A Colombian military plane carrying 125 people crashed in what the defence minister has described as a tragic accident, though the cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Have Israel, the US and Iran violated international law?
stories.summary: Civilian targets have been struck by Israel, the United States, and Iran during ongoing hostilities between the three parties.

stories.title: Smotrich urges Israel to annex southern Lebanon as assault intensifies
stories.summary: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, a far-right politician, has called for Israel to annex southern Lebanon up to the Litani River as Israeli military operations in Lebanon intensify.

stories.title: Iranian officials dismiss claims of US talks
stories.summary: Senior Iranian officials have denied reports that Iran held talks with the United States.

stories.title: Moment missile strikes shortly after Israeli president’s visit
stories.summary: A missile struck near Israeli President Isaac Herzog shortly after he concluded a press conference, forcing him to take cover.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes key Russian oil port and refinery
stories.summary: Ukraine announced it struck a major Russian oil terminal at Primorsk and a refinery in Ufa on Monday.

stories.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
stories.summary: Oil prices fell and global stock markets rebounded after US President Donald Trump announced that productive talks had been held to end the war.

stories.title: A pharmacist and a homesick lifestyle blogger: The 'alarming' civilian cost of war in Iran
stories.summary: Civilian casualties are rising in Iran as the US-Israeli military campaign continues, with victims including a pharmacist and a lifestyle blogger among those affected.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town, South Africa, found former Scottish teacher Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student who accused him of sexual abuse dating back to the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is limiting options for a resolution, with Iran showing no willingness to back down and US air power alone proving insufficient to achieve its primary objectives.

stories.title: Blast that injured two was 'terrorist attack', Ukrainian authorities say
stories.summary: Ukrainian authorities have classified a blast that injured two people as a terrorist attack, with the 21-year-old suspect claiming he was blackmailed into planting the explosives.

stories.title: Australia's ABC staff to go on strike for first time in 20 years
stories.summary: Staff at Australia's national broadcaster ABC plan to stage a 24-hour strike, the first in 20 years, which is expected to disrupt live television and radio programming.

stories.title: Germany has a shortage of workers - so it's turning to India for help
stories.summary: Germany is recruiting skilled workers from India to address a domestic labor shortage.

stories.title: France's Socialists hold on to power in major cities in election boost for mainstream
stories.summary: France's Socialist Party retained control of Paris and Marseille in local elections, while the nationalist right won in Nice and several other towns.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian driver while on a quad bike.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced its second complete power grid failure within a week, highlighting the country's ongoing energy crisis amid a US-imposed fuel blockade.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand both ground and air operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising concerns about a potential large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
stories.summary: Iranian ballistic missiles struck towns near an Israeli nuclear facility, injuring 180 people and prompting an Israeli investigation into how the missiles penetrated the country's air defense systems.

stories.title: Sudan drone attack on key hospital killed 64 people during Eid, WHO says
stories.summary: A drone strike on a hospital in Sudan during Eid killed 64 people, including 13 children, two nurses, and a doctor, according to the World Health Organization.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A car was stolen with a two-month-old baby inside, but police quickly rescued the infant unharmed and reunited him with his mother.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defence minister by Vice President Delcy Rodríguez, a move that human rights organizations have criticized.
